messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rate detected for api-gateway-us-east (502/504 spike). alert_id=pg-48231 severity=high. 90s avg 5xx rate = 18%. paging alice.sre and brian.oncall.

alice.sre: acked. jumping in. which region?

brian.oncall: I saw the grafana alert. us-east region (edge cluster e-us-1). lots of 502s coming from the gateway front proxy to upstream router.

carla.platform: I'm seeing huge queue depth on the edge proxies in us-east-1, and a spike in connection resets. Not all edge nodes but a subset (edge-a{3..6}).

alice.sre: ok assigning incident. alice.sre (lead triage), brian.oncall (primary), oliver.ops (traffic ops), dmitri.rt (runtime). eve.support to collect customer impact.

eve.support: marking customer-impact: investigating inbound support tickets. early access customers A & B reported timeouts. will post any SLA-risk accounts.

alice.sre: quick checks: nginx front-proxy logs show repeated HTTP 502 with upstream timeout messages. posting sample: ```
2026-04-09T14:12:08Z proxy[edge-a3] upstream_timeout "GET /v1/generate 502" x-request-id=abcd-1234
```

brian.oncall: running quick curl test to edge-a3: ```bash
curl -v -H 'Host: api.redwood.test' 'https://edge-a3.us-east-1.redwood/api/v1/health' --max-time 5
``` response: TLS OK but connection resets and `HTTP/1.1 502` intermittently.

oliver.ops: I can temporarily remove edge-a3 from LB rotation. want me to drain it?

alice.sre: yes drain edge-a3 and edge-a4. start graceful drain to avoid client errors spamming. oliver, do a 30s connection drain then remove.

oliver.ops: starting drain now. `kubectl scale deployment edge-proxy-a3 --replicas=0 --namespace=edge-us-east` then wait for connection_count==0.

carla.platform: also raising proxy upstream timeout from 10s to 15s as a short-term mitigation so transient congestion doesn't flip to 502s. applying to all edge proxies in us-east.

brian.oncall: I'm seeing a pattern: high KV cache miss rate around the same window. could be cache DB saturation causing upstream slowness. dmitri, any runtime changes recently?

dmitri.rt: No deployment in the last 6 hours. We did push a config tweak to the caching tier last night (ttl change) but that was rolled weeks ago. I'll check cache metrics.

dmitri.rt: cache cluster us-east-1-redis shows increased write latency and CPU at 92%. hitting maxconn briefly. logs: ```
[2026-04-09T14:10:52Z] redis-metrics WARN slowlog 1.2s  -- key=kv:prefetch:abc
```

alice.sre: that would explain upstream timeouts. oliver, after drain do a controlled route failover from e-us-1 to e-us-2 for a subset of traffic (10%) to validate recovery.

oliver.ops: starting canary failover for 10% to us-east-2 via traffic-router. command: `trafficctl shift --from edge-us-east --to edge-us-east-2 --percent 10 --tag incident-2415`

carla.platform: also enabling emergency autoscaling on cache cluster (scale +2 replicas) and increasing maxclients to 10k for the pool; monitoring in progress.

eve.support: customers A & B confirmed degraded performance but not complete outage; posting to status page draft: "We are investigating elevated API errors in US-East, some customers may see 502/504 responses." Approve?

alice.sre: approve. post now with aliasing so we can update.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood: INC-2415000000 - Elevated 5xx rates in us-east (investigating).

brian.oncall: after draining nodes and scaling cache, 5xx rate dropped from 18% to ~4% over 3 minutes. graph: error_rate -> 18% -> 6% -> 3.8%. continuing watch.

dmitri.rt: cache write latency back to baseline after scaling. redis CPU 45%. slowlogs cleared.

oliver.ops: rolling back the `timeout` bump? recommend leave at 15s for 30min to avoid flip-flop, then revert once stable.

carla.platform: agreed. also keeping edge-a3/4 removed from rotation until healthcheck steady for 10m.

alice.sre: customer impact summary for postmortem: transient elevated 502/504s in us-east affecting ~7% of requests for ~14 minutes, root cause: cache cluster resource saturation -> upstream timeouts. Mitigation: drained unhealthy edge nodes, scaled cache, increased proxy timeout, routing canary to healthy region.

eve.support: logged affected customers and sent targeted notices to A & B; support inbox will hold for any escalations.

brian.oncall: handoff to oliver.ops for monitoring / rollback at 14:40 UTC. I'll be available on-call but switching to follow mode.

oliver.ops: taking lead. I'll keep watch and update at 14:50 or earlier if regressions. :eyes:

alice.sre: thanks team. creating incident ticket INC-2415000000 and assigning to eng-runtime (dmitri) + platform (carla) for deep-dive. We'll convene postmortem tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2415000000 acknowledged and created. Pager duty incident closed.

oliver.ops: final note: retained logs & slowlogs archived to s3://incidents/2415000000/ for postmortem.

alice.sre: closing thread here, will add notes to postmortem doc. :thumbsup:
